text.n01: In my hood, whatever number you say out loud... that's how many of you pull up!
text.n02: So nobody round here says numbers. Like, EVER.
text.n03: The corner store don't even have prices!
text.n05: And math class? Ms. Johnson just be guessing.
text.n07: Milo, baby, how old are you?
text.n07b: Okay okay okay... just say a number, bro. How bad could it be?
text.n11: And not ONE of 'em did the homework.
text.n12: Yo! It's like a MILLION of us!
text.n15: Y'all stay CALM! Whatever you do... do NOT say ZERO!
text.n16: And that's when my baby brother said his first word...
